title: Filter detections using shoreline buffer, sea ice masks, fixed-structure removal, road/bridge offsets, and radar ambiguity removal
description: Apply data filtering steps to reduce false detections and artifacts: (1) restrict valid detection areas using a compiled global shoreline and remove a 1 km buffer from shore; (2) mask regions with sea ice using MASIE-NH plus predefined seasonal ice bounding boxes; (3) remove repeated objects across images (fixed structures) from vessel-detection dataset to exclude infrastructure and long-anchored vessels; (4) remove detections consistent with reflections from vehicles on bridges/roads close to shore by computing expected offset polygons (based on road proximity and assumed vehicle speeds) and excluding detections within them; (5) identify and remove radar ambiguities ('ghosts') by analyzing off-nadir angle bins and azimuth offsets, flagging detection pairs aligned with the satellite ground track and selecting the smaller/dimmer as ambiguity; (6) optionally cluster fixed structures over time (e.g., DBSCAN within 50 m) for infrastructure time series consistency.

inputs.sar_scenes: SAR imagery and acquisition geometry metadata

outputs.filtered_detections: Detections after applying masks and artifact removal
